main_text.p: רגז m. רגזה f. Commotio, Ira.
ארגו Vide suo loco in א.
רגל Obtrectare, Detrahere. Pihel רגל idem: item Explorare. Hiphil הרגיל Assue-facere.

רגל c. Pes: duale, רגלים Pedes, bini proprie, ut in bipedibus, sed quadrupedibus, etiam & insectis multipedibus tribuitur, quod in illis bis bini pedes, aut duo ordines pedum sint loco duorum. Plures autem pedes ipsis tributi sunt, quod non erecto, ut bipedes, sed in transversum strato corpore incedunt. Sic Chald. רגליא & רגליא, Pedes, Dan.2 41. & 7.4: רגלהי Pedes ejus, ברגליה Pedibus suis.
רגל Rogel, nomen proprium fontis, Jos 15.7. Quidam Fullonem explicant, quòd is pannos inter lavandum pedibus calcat.
רגלי m. Pedes, Pedites: plur. רגלים pro רגלים Pedites.
רגלים m.p. Vices, Tempora, quibus convenitur.

page.notes: Hebrew headwords and several Hebrew words in the entries are set in the margin or interlinear position and are only approximately read; the top folio mark is doubtful. Several Hebrew forms could not be read with certainty and may differ in pointing from the print.
